Ben (Finance): Alert: promo SAVINGS-APR inadvertently applied to vendor invoice INV-88420 (should be excluded). @Marisol can you confirm customer preference?
BillingBot: Promo SAVINGS-APR applied to INV-88420 by rule 'promo-batch-2026' (id: promo-0426).
Marisol (Customer Success): Reached out. Customer prefers refund rather than a future credit. They paid the invoice already.
Chen (Accounting): Refund is fine. Need finance sign-off and GL mapping. Refund amount is $420.00.
Omar (Sales): Filing bug with experiments team to exclude vendor and commit customers. Ticket EXP-EXCLUDE-710 created.
Ben (Finance): Approved refund. Post as manual refund RF-309, GL 6100-refunds, add note 'promo misapplied by promo-batch-2026'.
Chen (Accounting): Creating RF-309 and issuing refund via payment gateway. Attaching transaction ID once done.
BillingBot: Refund RF-309 queued. Status: processing.
Marisol (Customer Success): I'll email the customer confirmation once refund clears. Template: "We've refunded $420 for the misapplied promo SAVINGS-APR; sorry for the inconvenience."
Chen (Accounting): Refund processed, txn id TXN-778211. Posted RF-309 to account and closed adjustment.
BillingBot: Action complete. Audit note added to INV-88420.
Ben (Finance): Closing loop: refund issued, GL 6100 used, ticket EXP-EXCLUDE-710 opened. Thanks all.
